title: vtc-server: tests for server-set/immutable fields
description: Split from JMAP-t8ej.13 (batch 43 did only the chat half; the agent wrongly treated these as part of the deferred livestream work, which they are not). Oracle: '(server-set)'/'(immutable)' attributes at jmap-chat-spec 77c3474 (from 639dc1d). Code already rejects these (crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/backend.rs SERVER_SET/IMMUTABLE; vtc-server participant.rs). Tests: VTCParticipant/set create and update setting e2eeFingerprint -> invalidProperties; update setting plain gatewayData -> invalidProperties (pendingSignal path stays allowed); VTCCall/set update setting joinUri -> invalidProperties (extend the loop at tests/call_state.rs ~L296). Use a value different from the stored one (RFC 8620 §5.3 allows an identical server-set value). Test-only; do not touch livestream config/STREAM_CONFIG (JMAP-t8ej.10).
